record.question: The book 'Celestial Bodies' is authored by:
record.explanation: Answer A: Jokha Alharthi. Celestial Bodies is the novel by Jokha Alharthi, translated into English by Marilyn Booth; it won the 2019 International Booker Prize. Reference: https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/books/celestial-bodies. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated).
